description: This file contains the implementation of a port allocator for testing clusters in the Orleans framework. It manages port allocation, ensuring ports are free and not in use, and handles synchronization via mutexes to prevent conflicts during parallel test runs.

classes.name: TestClusterPortAllocator
classes.description: Implements port allocation logic for testing clusters, including methods to allocate port pairs and manage resources.

classes.name: MutexManager
classes.description: Manages mutexes for port allocation synchronization, running a background thread to handle lock acquisition and release.

methods.name: AllocateConsecutivePortPairs
methods.description: Allocates two sets of consecutive ports for cluster use, each with a specified number of ports.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Releases resources held by the port allocator.

methods.name: Dispose(bool)
methods.description: Handles the actual disposal logic, releasing mutexes and cleaning up.

methods.name: GetAvailableConsecutiveServerPorts
methods.description: Finds a range of available consecutive ports that are free and not in use.

methods.name: OnAppDomainUnload
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the application domain unloads.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Stops the mutex management thread and releases all mutexes.

methods.name: Acquire
methods.description: Attempts to acquire a mutex lock for a given port name, indicating exclusive access.

methods.name: SignalRelease
methods.description: Releases a mutex lock for a given port name.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Background thread method that processes lock/unlock actions for mutexes.
